headline_cluster.headline: שתי ערים צמודות, שני קצוות: באחת שיא במעשנים, בשנייה שפל בהשמנה
headline_cluster.body_note: Fetched via WebFetch; got figures from the National Program for Quality Indicators in Community Medicine (led by the National Institute for Health Policy Research), based on 4 HMOs' data, 2025 report: Bat Yam smoking 33.5% men / 22.6% women vs national 27.2%/11.9%; Tel Aviv obesity 15.6% men / 17.3% women (national lows); Bat Yam children obesity 11.3% at age 7.
